subject: EverMart: Stability commitments, RCA delivery, and follow-through register
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Courtney Perez <cperez@evermart.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@evermart.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Draft RCA + proposed commitments for last week's outage

Courtney / Rajiv —

Thanks again for your patience during last Wednesday's stability incident that impacted inference latency and elevated 5xxs for a 40-minute window. Attached is the latest RCA draft (EverMart_RCA_v1.3.pdf) and an initial commitments register. This version adds the timeline we walked through yesterday and the preliminary mitigation owner assignments we discussed on the bridge.

High-level summary (TL;DR):
- Root cause: regression in batching heuristics combined with a redis shard GC spike in us-west that caused request drops and queuing pressure on dedicated pools.
- Impact window: 2027-05-26T13:14:00Z — 2027-05-26T13:55:00Z; peak 99th token latency increased ~6x; error rate peaked at 3.7%.
- Immediate mitigations taken: disabled the experimental batching heuristic; failover to cold KV cache on affected hosts; raised autoscale target for dedicated pool for EverMart.

Requested asks:
1) Courtney — please confirm executive readout timing. We can present a concise 15-min briefing Tue 10:00am PT or Wed 2:00pm PT.
2) Rajiv / EverMart SRE — review the attached throughput-analysis.csv for any customer-side traffic patterns that might have amplified the effect.
3) Internal owners (Jonas, Marissa, Karthik) — see inline owners in the register and confirm feasibility for the proposed deadlines.

Next steps we propose in the register: a canary of the revised batching policy (controlled rollout) + forced KV shard GC tuning, and a Smart routing policy to avoid dispatching to affected pools during restarts. Proposed deadlines are in the register.

I'll get this into the shared drive and push a short executive one-pager after we get the readout slot.

Regards,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
(attachment: EverMart_RCA_v1.3.pdf)
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@evermart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Courtney Perez <cperez@evermart.com>
Cc: EverMart SRE Team <sre@evermart.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft RCA + proposed commitments for last week's outage

Thanks Mina — 

Got the files and initial read. Two quick clarifications from our side:
- We saw a small burst of traffic from a marketing campaign at 13:10 UTC, but peak QPS is within the profile we shared last quarter. I've asked SRE to correlate ten-minute buckets to see if client-side retries created amplification.
- For the executive readout, Courtney prefers Tue 10:00am PT.

Action for Redwood: please prioritize the canary plan and give us a short runbook snippet we can keep on our side for rapid failover to the cold cache path.

I'll loop in our platform lead if we need any assisted runs. Appreciate the thoroughness on the timeline.

—Rajiv
Rajiv Menon
VP Engineering, EverMart Retail
(attachment referenced: internal log slices uploaded to EverMart S3)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@evermart.com>, EverMart SRE Team <sre@evermart.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft RCA + proposed commitments for last week's outage

Mina / team —

I've reviewed the throughput-analysis.csv and cross-referenced it with our trace samples. Quick notes: 
- The experimental batching heuristic increases max-batch-size opportunistically; when combined with the transient KV GC it allowed a small number of requests to stall while other requests in the batch timed out, resulting in built-up tail latency and some upstream retries.
- Proposed immediate owners (I took the liberty to assign):
  * Batching policy rollback & controlled canary: Jonas Weber (owner), target canary Mon-Wed next week at 1% traffic, then 10% if stable.
  * KV shard GC tuning & monitoring: Karthik Iyer (owner), will adjust GC windows and add alerts for >250ms shard pause.
  * Autoscale policy bump and validation for EverMart pools: Marissa Cole (owner), will validate target CPU/GPU headroom and update SLA docs.

I'll prepare the canary playbook (short) and a one-page runbook for Rajiv's team so they can initiate the cold-cache failover if we see re-occurrence. Assignments and proposed deadlines are in the attached commitment-register-template.xlsx; please confirm.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: commitment-register-template.xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@evermart.com>, Courtney Perez <cperez@evermart.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft RCA + proposed commitments for last week's outage

Looping Priya for exec communication support and to book the Tue 10am PT readout with Courtney. 

Quick status update on the owner tasks: 
- I've validated autoscale bump works in staging for the EverMart pool and run a backfill simulation; no regressions observed. Will push config to canary pool tonight at 23:00 PT behind a feature flag.
- Working with infra to confirm there are no quota implications across accounts.

For the readout, I'll prepare a single-slide slide deck that includes the timeline, impact, RCA bullet, live mitigation, and the commitment register headline items. Priya — can you please prepare the executive intro & risk statement?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference

2) Root cause summary (Mina)
3) Immediate mitigations and canary plan (Marissa / Jonas)
4) Commitment register and deadlines (Karthik)

I've attached the readout slot invite to the calendar and a short executive note. Post-readout we'll move the commitment register into an operational Jira (SUP-1123) and track completion per milestone.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. The readout was helpful and the register looks actionable. Two follow-ups from my side: 
- Please send the canary playbook and the short runbook for the cold-cache path by end of day Thu so our SREs can validate.
- We want an SLA credit calculation estimate on the impact window; can someone from your finance or ops team provide a ballpark by Friday?

Rajiv and I will review the commitment register internally and flag any conflicts. Appreciate the clarity and the owner assignments — this level of ownership is exactly what we needed.

Courtney Perez
Chief Product Officer, EverMart Retail
